blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Six wanted individuals, including the two most wanted suspects in Bislig City, Surigao del Sur, were arrested in separate police operations across the Caraga region on Friday, November 27. Brig. Gen. Rolindo M. Suguilon, director of Police Regional Office 13 (PRO13), said personnel from the Bislig City Police Station captured the city’s top most wanted person, identified only as alias “Nelly,” 31, of Barangay Tabon, Bislig City.
